items.source:
Exception thrown in case of a reference to a bean that's currently in creation.
Typically happens when constructor autowiring matches the currently constructed bean.
items.translation: 在引用当前正在创建的 Bean 时抛出异常。通常发生在构造函数自动装配匹配到当前正在构建的 Bean 时。

items.source:
Create a new BeanCurrentlyInCreationException,
with a default error message that indicates a circular reference.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 BeanCurrentlyInCreationException，其默认错误消息指示存在循环引用。

items.source: beanName - the name of the bean requested
items.translation: beanName - 请求的 Bean 的名称
